verdict.rationale: Ledgy's own marketing says admins can create custom vesting schedules and vary them by group, which directly addresses the core of the story. The claim is a single thin marketing line with no documented detail on schedule types or automatic tracking. missing for 10: documented cliff support, milestone-based vesting, acceleration-on-exit triggers, automatic vested vs unvested tracking, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: Switch up vesting schedules for different groups, or create custom vesting to reflect your needs.
